user_query: I'm looking for some new games to play with my friends. Can you suggest some trending memes and top quality memes that can be used as inspiration for new games? Additionally, I would like to gather information about rising popular posts on Reddit to ensure a fun and entertaining game night.

TaskList.description: Gather trending memes from social media platforms
Collect top quality memes based on user ratings
Fetch rising popular posts from Reddit related to gaming and memes
Compile a list of game ideas using the gathered memes and posts
